messages.subject: RJ Energy IB Referral - Jonathan Nachman
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

My name is David Talbot, and I am a first year analyst at Raymond James in the Energy Investment Banking Group. Hope your spring semester if off to a great start.

I was sent your resume and was asked to connect with you by Sonu. I would be happy to talk sometime about recruiting/RJ Analyst experience. Please let me know some times that are good for you and we can put something on the calendar.

I've attached your resume just to have it on the email chain.

Best,

David Talbot
Energy Investment Banking

5847 San Felipe St., Suite 3800 Houston, TX 77057
RAYMOND JAMES & ASSOCIATES, INC.
